summary: Actelis Networks filed an 8-K regarding an Exchange and Amendment Agreement with White Lion Capital LLC. The Company issued 9,850,000 shares of common stock (comprising Amendment Commitment Shares, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants) to settle White Lion's rights under a prior Common Stock Purchase Agreement after Actelis was delisted from Nasdaq on April 10, 2026. Terms include a $0.0001 exercise price on pre-funded warrants and conditions tied to a reverse stock split or authorized share increase. The filing reflects a distressed equity line adjustment, not a standard special situation. Watch for further financing steps or re-listing efforts.
